acceptance: Maintenance handlers issue a bounded number of statements per operation, not per row.
Post-maintenance table row counts and checksums match the current implementation for a fixed seed.
Maintenance time at SF1 on DuckDB drops measurably.
description: benchbox/core/tpcds/maintenance_operations.py:215 starts the timer before handlers run. _update_customer, _update_item, _update_inventory, _bulk_update_inventory (:498-722) send one parameterized UPDATE per row (one round trip per row on cloud warehouses). Sales inserts (:314-370) build rows with Python random and send 100-row VALUES batches. _insert_returns_generic (:371-430) fetchall()s sales rows to Python and rebuilds them. Use set-based SQL (UPDATE ... FROM (SELECT ...), INSERT ... SELECT) or a staged bulk load, keeping results deterministic.
